changes.title: A crowded week
changes.briefing: Rain over Vienna. Recruiting parties in the streets; the court watches who is seen with whom.

whereabouts.doing: deep in talk by the gate

reports.title: A sum that does not agree
reports.text: Your Excellency asked for the chests. The day book shows a remittance from Linz entered twice.

reports.title: The Breslau magazine
reports.text: Wallis asks whether to move the Breslau magazine to Neisse now, before the roads close. He needs an answer today.

urgent.prompt: Harrach waits for your answer before he writes to Wallis.

options.label: Move the magazine to Neisse at once

letters.title: The wagons are rolling
letters.text: The first wagons left for Neisse this morning.

remarks: Wallis moves the Breslau magazine on your word.

options.label: Let Wallis decide on the spot

remarks: Wallis was left to decide about the magazine himself.

reports.title: Quiet at Glogau
reports.text: All quiet at Glogau. The roads are deep in mud.

canon: A remittance from Linz was entered twice in the Hofkammer day book.
hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: a week of rain; Kessler finds a double entry; Wallis asks about the Breslau magazine.

decisions.knows: The Emperor is dead; Vienna is in mourning and short of money.
decisions.decides: Keeps his counsel and orders the regiments readied, quietly.
